props.doc:
Firewalls, DNS security and proxies: blocking at the perimeter.

Every block command here takes an expiry. A blocklist that only grows is an
outage waiting to happen, and the one thing a SOC never gets round to is
reviewing entries added during an incident at 03:00.
props.name: network_connectors

props.code:
def param(kind, **extra):
    """One input property, in JSON Schema terms."""
    spec = {"type": kind} if kind not in ("ipv4", "hostname") else {"type": "string"}
    spec.update(extra)
    return spec


def cmd(key, name, method, url, inputs, outputs, extract=None, risk="low",
        effect="read", doc="", techniques=None, undo=None, timeout_ms=30000,
        required=None, category="integration", body=None, success=None):
    """
    One command definition.

    Structured JSON in, structured JSON out. The output_schema is what the
    playbook validator type-checks the next step against, so a command whose
    schema lies fails at publish rather than at 03:00.
    """
    definition = {
        "key": key,
        "name": name,
        "category": category,
        "kind": "http",
        "input_schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "required": list(inputs.keys()) if required is None else required,
            "properties": inputs,
            "additionalProperties": False,
        },
        "output_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": outputs},
        "implementation": {
            "method": method,
            "url": url,
            "extract": extract or {},
            "success_codes": success or [200, 201, 202, 204],
        },
        "required_permissions": ["commands.execute"],
        "required_capabilities": ["net"],
        "timeout_ms": timeout_ms,
        "risk_level": risk,
        "effect": effect,
        "trust_level": "trusted",
        "technique_ids": techniques or [],
        "doc": doc,
    }
    if body is not None:
        definition["implementation"]["body"] = body
    if effect == "mutating":
        # A mutating command with no dry-run example would make dry run a lie,
        # and the registry validator refuses it.
        definition["dry_run_example"] = {"dry_run": True, "would_call": key}
    if undo:
        # Named, not inferred. The platform never invents a rollback.
        definition["undo_command"] = undo
    if risk == "high":
        definition["required_permissions"] = ["commands.execute", _permission_for(key)]
    return definition


def _permission_for(key):
    """High-risk commands need the response permission that matches them."""
    action = key.split(".", 1)[1]
    if "isolate" in action or "contain" in action or "quarantine_host" in action:
        return "response.isolate"
    if "block" in action:
        return "response.block"
    if "disable" in action or "suspend" in action:
        return "response.disable_account"
    if "revoke" in action or "signout" in action:
        return "response.revoke_sessions"
    if "delete" in action or "purge" in action or "remove_mail" in action:
        return "response.delete_mail"
    if "firewall" in action or "policy" in action:
        return "response.firewall"
    return "response.isolate"


def field(name, label, kind="text", required=True, default=None,
          options=None, help="", placeholder=""):
    # One thing an operator must be told before this tool can be reached.
    return {
        "name": name, "label": label, "kind": kind, "required": required,
        "default": default, "options": options or [], "help": help,
        "placeholder": placeholder,
    }


def connector(cid, name, vendor, category, auth, base_url, allowlist, commands,
              min_permissions=None, rate_limit=None, health=None,
              version="1.0.0", setup=None, derive=None, ingest=None,
              hunt=None):
    # A connector manifest. Installing one publishes its commands; no engine
    # change.
    #
    # setup is what THIS vendor needs before it can be reached, and no two
    # agree: CrowdStrike wants a cloud region, Sentinel a tenant and a
    # workspace, Splunk a host and a port. Asking every connector for a
    # client id and a secret asked the two questions they happen to share
    # and none of the ones that make a connection work.
    fields = list(setup or [])

    # Which setting the commands of this connector actually read. Most say
    # base_url; a few front a protocol that is not HTTP and say gateway_url
    # instead, and asking those for a base_url nothing reads is how a form
    # grows a field that does nothing.
    setting = "base_url"
    if "{{" in base_url:
        inner = base_url.split("{{", 1)[1].split("}}", 1)[0].strip()
        setting = inner.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] if inner else "base_url"

    if not any(f["name"] == setting for f in fields):
        # Every connector can at least be pointed elsewhere: a regional
        # cloud, a tenant-specific host, an on-premise appliance.
        # A connector whose base_url is itself a template has no host until
        # someone supplies one, so there is nothing to prefill and the field
        # is the only way the connection can exist at all.
        templated = "{{" in base_url
        fields.insert(0, field(
            setting, "API base URL", kind="url",
            default=None if templated else base_url,
            help="Change for a regional cloud or an on-premise appliance."
                 if not templated else "The hostname this tenant answers on."))

    return {
        "setup": fields,
        # Settings a vendor addresses by a composite of the ones a person
        # can actually be asked for. Nobody knows their workspace ARM id;
        # everybody knows their subscription, resource group and workspace
        # name, and the id is those three in a fixed shape.
        "derive": derive or {},
        # How this product is polled for alerts: which command lists them,
        # which turns ids into objects, and where the timestamp lives that
        # the watermark advances to. A connector without it can still
        # receive a webhook; it just cannot be asked.
        "ingest": ingest or {},
        # Which command runs an arbitrary hunt query, what the query
        # parameter is called, and what language an engineer is writing.
        # A tool without this cannot be hunted in - which is most of them,
        # because a firewall is not a place you go looking.
        "hunt": hunt or {},
        "id": cid, "name": name, "vendor": vendor, "category": category,
        "version": version, "auth": auth, "base_url": base_url,
        "egress_allowlist": allowlist,
        "min_vendor_permissions": min_permissions or [],
        "rate_limit": rate_limit or {},
        "health_check": health or {},
        "commands": commands,
        "publisher": "master-soar",
        "signature": "",
    }


blocked = {"blocked": {"type": "boolean"}, "entry_id": {"type": "string"}}

panos = connector(
    "paloalto.panos", "Palo Alto NGFW", "Palo Alto Networks", "network",
    {"kind": "api_key", "roles": ["api_key"], "header": "X-PAN-KEY"},
    "{{ integration.config.base_url }}",
    ["{{ integration.config.host }}"],
    min_permissions=["XML API: Configuration, Commit"],
    health={"path": "/api/?type=op&cmd=<show><system><info></info></system></show>"},
    setup=[
        field("base_url", "Firewall or Panorama URL", kind="url",
              placeholder="https://firewall.client.example"),
        field("vsys", "Virtual system", required=False,
              default="vsys1"),
    ],
    commands=[
        cmd("panos.block_ip", "PAN-OS: Block IP", "POST",
            "{{ integration.config.base_url }}/restapi/v10.2/Objects/AddressGroups",
            {"ip": param("string"),
             "group": param("string", pattern="^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,63}$"),
             "expires_days": param("integer", minimum=1, maximum=365),
             "comment": param("string")},
            blocked, risk="high", effect="mutating", undo="panos.unblock_ip",
            required=["ip", "group", "comment"],
            doc="Adds to a dynamic address group the policy already references, so "
                "no rule change and no commit of a new policy is needed."),

        cmd("panos.unblock_ip", "PAN-OS: Unblock IP", "DELETE",
            "{{ integration.config.base_url }}/restapi/v10.2/Objects/AddressGroups?name={{ inputs.group | urlencode }}&member={{ inputs.ip | urlencode }}",
            {"ip": param("string"), "group": param("string")},
            {"removed": {"type": "boolean"}},
            risk="medium", effect="mutating"),

        cmd("panos.block_url", "PAN-OS: Block URL", "POST",
            "{{ integration.config.base_url }}/restapi/v10.2/Objects/CustomURLCategories",
            {"url": param("string"), "category": param("string"),
             "comment": param("string")},
            blocked, risk="high", effect="mutating"),

        cmd("panos.commit", "PAN-OS: Commit Configuration", "POST",
            "{{ integration.config.base_url }}/api/?type=commit&cmd=<commit></commit>",
            {}, {"job_id": {"type": "string"}},
            risk="high", effect="mutating", required=[], timeout_ms=300000,
            doc="Separate from the block commands on purpose: a playbook can add "
                "several objects and commit once, and a failed commit is visible "
                "as its own failed step."),
    ],
)

fortigate = connector(
    "fortinet.fortigate", "Fortinet FortiGate", "Fortinet", "network",
    {"kind": "api_key", "roles": ["api_key"], "header": "Authorization",
     "prefix": "Bearer "},
    "{{ integration.config.base_url }}",
    ["{{ integration.config.host }}"],
    health={"path": "/api/v2/monitor/system/status"},
    setup=[
        field("base_url", "FortiGate URL", kind="url",
              placeholder="https://fortigate.client.example"),
        field("vdom", "VDOM", required=False, default="root"),
    ],
    commands=[
        cmd("fortigate.block_ip", "FortiGate: Block IP", "POST",
            "{{ integration.config.base_url }}/api/v2/cmdb/firewall/address",
            {"ip": param("string"), "group": param("string"),
             "comment": param("string")},
            blocked, risk="high", effect="mutating",
            undo="fortigate.unblock_ip",
            body={"name": "soar-{{ inputs.ip }}", "subnet": "{{ inputs.ip }} 255.255.255.255",
                  "comment": "{{ inputs.comment }}"}),

        cmd("fortigate.unblock_ip", "FortiGate: Unblock IP", "DELETE",
            "{{ integration.config.base_url }}/api/v2/cmdb/firewall/address/soar-{{ inputs.ip | urlencode }}",
            {"ip": param("string")}, {"removed": {"type": "boolean"}},
            risk="medium", effect="mutating"),
    ],
)

umbrella = connector(
    "cisco.umbrella", "Cisco Umbrella", "Cisco", "network",
    {"kind": "oauth2_client", "roles": ["client_id", "client_secret"],
     "token_url": "https://api.umbrella.com/auth/v2/token"},
    "https://api.umbrella.com",
    ["api.umbrella.com"],
    health={"path": "/admin/v2/organizations"},
    setup=[
        field("organization_id", "Organization id",
              help="The number in the Umbrella dashboard URL."),
        field("destination_list_id", "Blocklist id", required=False,
              help="The destination list a block command writes to."),
    ],
    commands=[
        cmd("umbrella.block_domain", "Umbrella: Block Domain", "POST",
            "https://api.umbrella.com/policies/v2/destinationlists/{{ integration.config.destination_list_id }}/destinations",
            {"domain": param("string"), "comment": param("string")},
            blocked, {"entry_id": "$.data.id"},
            risk="high", effect="mutating", undo="umbrella.unblock_domain",
            body=[{"destination": "{{ inputs.domain }}",
                   "comment": "{{ inputs.comment }}"}]),

        cmd("umbrella.unblock_domain", "Umbrella: Unblock Domain", "DELETE",
            "https://api.umbrella.com/policies/v2/destinationlists/{{ integration.config.destination_list_id }}/destinations/remove",
            {"entry_id": param("string")}, {"removed": {"type": "boolean"}},
            risk="medium", effect="mutating",
            body=["{{ inputs.entry_id }}"]),

        cmd("umbrella.domain_status", "Umbrella: Domain Categorisation", "GET",
            "https://api.umbrella.com/investigate/v2/domains/categorization/{{ inputs.domain | urlencode }}",
            {"domain": param("string")},
            {"status": {"type": "integer"},
             "categories": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}}),
    ],
)

zscaler = connector(
    "zscaler.zia", "Zscaler Internet Access", "Zscaler", "network",
    {"kind": "api_key", "roles": ["api_key", "username", "password"]},
    "{{ integration.config.base_url }}",
    ["{{ integration.config.host }}"],
    health={"path": "/api/v1/status"},
    setup=[
        field("base_url", "ZIA cloud", kind="select",
              default="https://zsapi.zscaler.net",
              options=[{"value": "https://zsapi.zscaler.net",
                        "label": "zscaler.net"},
                       {"value": "https://zsapi.zscalerone.net",
                        "label": "zscalerone.net"},
                       {"value": "https://zsapi.zscalertwo.net",
                        "label": "zscalertwo.net"},
                       {"value": "https://zsapi.zscalerthree.net",
                        "label": "zscalerthree.net"},
                       {"value": "https://zsapi.zscloud.net",
                        "label": "zscloud.net"}],
              help="Shown in the ZIA admin portal under Administration > Company Profile."),
    ],
    commands=[
        cmd("zscaler.block_url", "Zscaler: Add URL to Blocklist", "POST",
            "{{ integration.config.base_url }}/api/v1/security/advanced/blacklistUrls?action=ADD_TO_LIST",
            {"urls": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"},
                      "minItems": 1, "maxItems": 100}},
            blocked, risk="high", effect="mutating", undo="zscaler.unblock_url",
            body={"blacklistUrls": "{{ inputs.urls | json }}"}),

        cmd("zscaler.unblock_url", "Zscaler: Remove URL from Blocklist", "POST",
            "{{ integration.config.base_url }}/api/v1/security/advanced/blacklistUrls?action=REMOVE_FROM_LIST",
            {"urls": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}},
            {"removed": {"type": "boolean"}},
            risk="medium", effect="mutating",
            body={"blacklistUrls": "{{ inputs.urls | json }}"}),
    ],
)

return [panos, fortigate, umbrella, zscaler]
